## From one-pool (2026-11-01, step 3 of brief-locks): the fork server retries its connect every 25 ms

`crates/blaze-usercode/src/test/fork_server.rs` `connect` (text written into each test harness) retries `UnixStream::connect` up to 400 times, sleeping 25 ms, on NotFound/ConnectionRefused: "blaze listens as it starts the binary; the listen may be made a moment after."

Cause: `crates/blaze-usercode/src/test/queue.rs` `spawn_server` pushes `Effect::Listen` and `Effect::Spawn` in one batch, so the driver may start the binary before the socket is bound.

What: push the spawn from `listened` once its listen succeeded (a failed listen ends the server with its error, no spawn), then make `connect` connect once and fail naming the socket. That removes a wait no event ends (rules every-wait-says-what, no-fallback: a server that can't connect today waits 10 s and then fails). Test on the queue: no `Effect::Spawn` before the listen's completion, and a refused listen spawns nothing.
